Definition: life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence, the world (as transient)
BiblicalUsage: This word is a lifetime, the span of a man's days, and also the world men live in. Zophar promises that Job's age will be clearer than the noonday, the men of the world have their portion in this life, the psalmist counts his age as nothing before God, the inhabitants of the world are called to hear, and the psalm asks God to remember how short our time is.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my lifetime is short and my portion is in this world only if I choose it there. The psalms count our days as nothing before God, and that is why I want my portion in Him, not in the world.
